patterns.note: A distinctive brand palette uses a deep olive green as a primary background and text color, complemented by a vibrant lime green for accents and calls to action.
Sections frequently alternate between full-bleed imagery and solid background colors (olive green, off-white, muted green) to create clear visual breaks and hierarchy.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, often in all caps, providing strong visual impact and clear section demarcation.
The top promotional banner slides out of view, and the main navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid muted green background, becoming sticky as the user scrolls down the page.
Full-screen modal overlays are used for promotional offers, featuring a split layout with product imagery on one side and interactive elements on the other.

technique_notes: A sticky header element transitions its background color and potentially height using CSS transitions or JavaScript to add/remove a class based on scroll position, while a top promotional banner is hidden on scroll.
Hero sections utilize full-bleed imagery with text content positioned over it, creating a layered effect where the text scrolls over the image.
Content sections are visually distinct through alternating background colors and full-bleed photography, often using grid layouts for product displays and feature comparisons.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, sans-serif headings (up to ~4x body) with clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some image containers, but mostly sharp edges for overall structure.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, especially in hero and section breaks, with tighter spacing in product grids.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated and consistent brand identity, achieved through a unique color palette of deep olive and vibrant lime green, paired with high-quality, aspirational product photography that elevates the everyday act of shaving into a luxurious experience.
